items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The band was called Willie Jones' band. But Jones left, Willie Jones -- I don't know what happened to him.

ctx.x: music director. The band was called Willie Jones' band. But Jones left, Willie Jones -- I don't know what happened to him.

Anyway, we got together, you know, with Speed, and Speed had very many promises, as they all do have. But nothing but promises. That's all. You dig? So we scuffled, and... Roy (Eldridge) was in the band and Teddy (Wilson) was in the band, and their brothers -- both had brothers, you know, and they were in the band.
